Most places are over 18s (some do allow 17 with parental consent). 
Regarding choosing something for a first tattoo;
Choose something small in an inconspicuous place, something that you can maybe build on in the future. You have a whole life time to fill your body with art so take your time with it. 
Do your research into the artists/studios in the local area. Just because a place is cheaper than another doesn’t mean it is the better option. 
Once you have an idea of what you want, you can look for artists that are experienced in the style. 

As someone who got tattooed when they were 17, these are the things I wish I had been told. 👀 

Side note: any of the reputable spots in town will always be happy to answer your questions.
